# Lokhus

> Lokhus is a personal console for Safe multisig accounts. One person keeps long-term crypto in a Safe that several of their own keys protect (hardware wallets, cards, phones, browser wallets), so losing one key cannot empty it.

- Every transaction is simulated against the chain first, so you approve what it does, not raw bytes.
- Signing walks you through your own wallets one at a time and shows which signature is still missing. Ledger, WalletConnect and browser wallets are supported.
- Swaps between any two tokens on the Safe's chain and supplying to the SODAX money market, with every quote and calldata checked in the browser before signing.
- Safe 1.3.0 and 1.4.1 on Polygon, Sonic, Base and Ethereum.
- Lokhus never holds keys or seed phrases. Transactions go straight to the chain over public RPCs; there is no Safe backend.
- Hosted at lokhus.com with passkey sign-in and end-to-end encrypted account data, or self-hosted with data in a local SQLite file.
- Independent project, not made or endorsed by Safe, SODAX or Robinhood. Source: https://github.com/paulrouge/lokhus (FSL-1.1-ALv2).
